original.target_description: Study 1, Hypothesis 1: young women judging other bodies as overweight; condition × trial × body size interaction in a logistic multilevel model.

n.sample_role: Women included in the final analysis; 206 stable-prevalence and 213 increasing-prevalence participants.
n.exclusions: From 563 recruited: excluded outside age 18–28, not self-identifying female, psychoactive substance use, failed catch question, or mean response time outside 100–7,000 ms. Ten practice trials not analyzed.
n.quote: data from 419 women were included in the final analysis

es.location: Results > Judgments of other bodies (Hypothesis 1), supplied p. 6; HTML line 115
es.quote: three-way interaction between condition, trial, and size (β = 3.85, SE = 0.38, p = 1.09 × 10−23)

p.location: Results > Judgments of other bodies (Hypothesis 1), supplied p. 6; HTML line 115

replication.target_description: Report #11 final replication of Hypothesis 1: condition × trial × body size interaction predicting overweight judgments in the logistic multilevel model, 201 women after exclusions.

n.sample_role: Participants in replication analysis of Hypothesis 1 after exclusions; repeated body-judgment observations nested within participants.
n.exclusions: Eligibility female, age 18–30, English speaking. Of 249 completing main task, 8 had technical data loss; exclusions reported for gender (8), age >30 (23), >10 responses longer than 7 seconds (6), erratic responding (4), with overlapping categories. Incomplete 800-trial tasks and ineligible participants excluded; observations >7 seconds excluded.
n.location: Summary of Study and Results, first paragraph; Excluding Participants and/or Observations
n.quote: Both the original study (n = 419) and our replication (n = 201)

es.metric: Log Odds (β; unstandardized logistic multilevel coefficient)
es.location: Results in Detail > Figure 6: Replication Results Table, Condition x Trial0 x Size0 row, Log Odds column

p.location: Results in Detail > Figure 6: Replication Results Table, Condition x Trial0 x Size0 row, p column

reported_success.quote: The original finding did not replicate.

notes: Original statistics verified directly in the original primary full HTML, not copied from the replication report. Original cache stores verified excerpts of that HTML because later retrievals timed out. Replication detailed Figure 6 prints p = 0.255, whereas its Results summary rounds this to 0.26 and gives SE = 1.81; retained the detailed table coefficient and p without recalculation. Replication authors caution that design-related low sensitivity means failure to replicate is not strong evidence against the hypothesis. No effect metrics were converted.
